Name: ZH's Artisanal Goods Plus - Blue Eggs and Golden Mayo
Author: ZoeyHoshi
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/LPmCk7W.png[/img]﻿[/center]
﻿﻿
First add-on mod for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29535]ZH's Artisanal Goods+[/url] for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/55537262]6480[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20266]Blue Eggs and Golden Mayo (Now with extra Ostrich)[/url], it can be used without [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29535]ZH's Artisanal Goods+[/url]﻿ but made to match with it.

This mod, like my others, is completely [i]configurable[/i]. Anything you don't like or want, you can simply disable alongside choose what style and colour you want.
[center]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/dIibzU8.png[/img]﻿﻿[/center]1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20266]Blue Eggs and Golden Mayo (Now with extra Ostrich)[/url]﻿.﻿
3. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for easy configurations
4. Download the main .zip file from this mod and install it
5. When starting the game for the first time since installing, use Generic Mod Config Menu to configure the mod to your liking

You're all done and ready to play.

[center]﻿﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/mTUL7Ne.png[/img]﻿[/center]﻿
